summary: When the validate option isn't enough, use block/rescue/always with backup: update the file with backup=yes, run your own validation, restore the backup in rescue on failure, and clean up in always.
questions: How do I roll back a config file if my validation command fails?
validate needs the real file name, what can I do instead?
How do I restore a backup made by template?

answer_card.title: Custom validate-and-rollback pattern
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- block:
    - template: {src: app.j2, dest: /etc/app.conf, backup: true}
      register: updated
    - command: app --check-config
      when: updated is changed
  rescue:
    - copy:
        remote_src: true
        src: "{{ updated.backup_file }}"
        dest: /etc/app.conf
      when: updated is changed
  always:
    - file: {path: "{{ updated.backup_file }}", state: absent}
      when: updated is changed
```
